visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand swiping a key card against a electronic door lock that glows blue, followed by the door opening to reveal a brightly lit hotel room with two twin beds and wood-paneled walls. (2) Close-up views of the washbasin area with marble textures and a closet containing robes and slippers, followed by a pan across the bathroom including a toilet and a glass-walled shower area. (3) A wooden desk is shown featuring a bowl of fruit and a clear jar of white aromatic crystals; a drawer is opened to reveal assorted coffee and tea packets. (4) A small white refrigerator is opened to show cans of soda and bottles of water; the camera then provides a wide perspective of the entire room layout from the corner. (5) A finger presses buttons on a wall-mounted smart control panel for lights and curtains; in the background, automated curtains are seen sliding shut. (6) The scene shifts to a communal laundry room with multiple stacked silver washing machines and dryers; a staff member in a tan vest is shown ironing clothes on a board. (7) The video concludes with a detailed price chart displayed on a screen, followed by a wide exterior shot of the hotel building at night with a large illuminated sign.

(2) A hollow 'thud' indicates the door closing. The narration continues at a steady pace, describing the beds and bathroom features. (4) The background atmosphere shifts to include a low-level mechanical hum representative of a laundry facility. The narrator highlights free services. (5) The video finishes with the BGM swelling slightly in volume before cutting out. The narration ends with a conclusive tone regarding the hotel's location and value.
